name: claudeholic-plugins
description: A personal collection of stable plugins that work with Claude Code, maintained by claudeholic.

plugins.name: chrome-shared
plugins.description: Shared Chrome automation: one browser instance for all Claude Code sessions, lazy launch, multiplexed engine, numbered tabs, no automation markers. Linux only.

plugins.name: linkedin-mcp
plugins.description: Unofficial wrapper that adds the LinkedIn MCP server (mcp-server-linkedin 4.23.3 by Daniel Sticker, Apache-2.0) to Claude Code via uvx. Profiles, companies, jobs, posts and messages through your own LinkedIn session. Not affiliated with LinkedIn.
